title: Inventory & Recommendations: Humanitarian Blockchain 2022
html:
Ever since 2016 when I released a paper on Blockhain’s potentials in the humanitarian sector, I have wondered about adoption in the sector. Not only the successful & unsuccessful ones, but lessons learned which should be shared to improve the odds for future projects. Over the years, various groups have surveyed the usage of Blockchain (e.g. 2017 Desk Review by the United Nations about the Usage of BlockChain in the UN System), but I rarely have seen reviews go beyond a typical inventory.

So, when Zoey Zhang joined me earlier this year and expressed an interest in Blockchain, I proposed that she build an inventory of Blockchain in the humanitarian sector BUT with a purpose of coming up with Dos and Don’ts for anyone thinking about implementing the technology in the sector. Zoey collected several implementation examples, dove deep into six case studies and outlined recommendations. Today, I am excited to share the final report Humanitarian Blockchain - Inventory and Recommendations

[PDF]

In the research phase, we came across a great tool that is worth sharing there - the Blockchain for Humanitarian Aid Decision Tree [PDF] from HumanityX and TUDelft.

Andrej
teaser: A report with Zoey Zhang on humanitarian blockchain: an inventory, six case studies and recommendations on what to do and avoid.
seo_description: Humanitarian Blockchain: Inventory and Recommendations, a 2022 report by Zoey Zhang and Andrej Verity with lessons from implementations in the sector.
